config.script:
# 1.5.0: one press - booth.safetyreset holds the area's HMI reset 3.5 s (clears a safety fault), waits out the
	# PLC's fault-reset pulse, then taps it 0.2 s (resets the groups). Runs on the gateway; a second press while it
	# runs is refused. Replaces the press-and-hold button (DDB: monitoring only - press() does nothing).
	booth.safetyreset.press(self.view.params.Area, self.session.props.auth.user.userName,
		'Diag view card %s' % self.page.props.path)

# 1.5.0: the Safety Diagnostics popup on this area (was: navigate to the old /Safety/<area> page)
	booth.safety.openDiag(self.view.params.Area)
